name: Sunday Lore / 3k Run / Indiranagar/ NOV 22
description:
Join Main Mission x Optimum Nutrition for Sunday Lore: a 3K community run in Indiranagar, followed by coffee at Brik oven, conversations and Optimum Nutrition whey protein, on us.

Start your Sunday moving with the community, then stay back to refuel and catch up. There'll also be free Optimum Nutrition winner packs and an additional 15% discount on all food products.

What To Expect

A 3K community run in Indiranagar, followed by free Optimum Nutrition whey protein and post-run coffee on us, plus free Optimum Nutrition winner packs.

At Brik oven- Choose from hot Americano, cold Americano, hot cappuccino or cold cappuccino. We'll provide coffee tokens to keep collection organised.

Staying to eat? Enjoy an additional 15% discount on all food products.

Who Is This For

Runners and community members looking to spend Sunday morning moving, meeting people and catching up over coffee.

What's Included

* Community 3K run

* Free Optimum Nutrition winner packs

* Free Optimum Nutrition whey protein

* Post-run coffee on us

* Additional 15% discount on all food products!
